module: Module 1: How Pay Works at Brunswick
title: Three Principles Behind Every Pay Decision

Head_01.text: Three Principles Behind Every Pay Decision

Statement_01.text: Not guesswork, not arbitrary numbers — real data for how similar roles are paid in the broader labor markets where those jobs are located

Statement_02.text: People doing similar work with similar comparable performance are compensated similarly.

Statement_03.text: Ratings and contributions influence progress through your pay range over time.

Impact_01.text: No single factor determines your pay — it's a system.

narration.text: Before we look at any of the specifics, it helps to understand how Brunswick sets pay. Every compensation decision — every offer, every increase, every pay range — is guided by the same three principles. First: We benchmark against market data compiled by reputable, third-party compensation surveys in which we participate along with hundreds of other companies. Not guesswork, not arbitrary numbers — real data for how similar roles are paid in the broader labor market. Second: We balance external competitiveness with internal equity. What the market pays matters, and so does fairness within Brunswick — people doing similar work with similar performance should be compensated similarly. Third: Pay is linked to performance. Your ratings and contributions influence how you progress through your pay range over time. These three principles work together. No single factor determines your pay — it's a system.
